findings.subject: Do not publish legacy auth sequences as current architecture
findings.detail: API core and frontend still describe path-based token/org gates and GitHub platform sign-in, while the current host uses endpoint-classified Entra/broker authentication and project roles. Assistant prose/sequence forwards an Entra caller token to MCP, which accepts only broker tokens. This is a blocker to approving those diagrams as current, not a request to modify runtime security code.

findings.subject: Production event delivery is database polling, not universal replay-to-channel
findings.detail: Merge the accurate 00-system-overview-fig8 production sequence into canonical-durable-event-stream-sequence, then move its sole consumer. Request shared-owner reconciliation of canonical-durable-event-stream and canonical-event-replay-tail if they imply per-replica channels provide cross-replica delivery; no foreign entry was edited.

findings.subject: Assistant Idle is not a terminal Completed run
findings.detail: The page's revival of Completed runs is obsolete. Idle conversations CAS-wake; a Completed row or durable run.completed seal returns 409 operator_run_closed. Preserve the 5/30 minute timers and held-pod behavior while correcting the lifecycle.

findings.subject: The all-MAF and all-RequestPort slogans have exceptions
findings.detail: Collective AssemblyReviewGate is service-driven and uses TaskCompletionSource; Operator conversations are a separate runtime path. The existing D3 handoff graphic is useful precisely because it prevents this conflation.

findings.subject: Data topology and child-workspace prose disagree with implementation
findings.detail: The legacy data graph says single writer/SqliteDb while production uses shared EF/Postgres and separate workers. The persistence page additionally says coordinator children share one worktree; actual StartChildRunAsync provisions each child its own. The overview AKS image should move to guide-owned canonical-aks-components after owner reconciliation.

findings.subject: Frontend deployment conventions are reversed in current prose
findings.detail: API_URL is origin-only, including the empty same-origin sentinel, not an /api base path. The web host redirects /docs to an external site rather than serving a bundled VitePress tree. Update both the hosting graphic and the repeated rebuild/convention prose.

findings.subject: Repository-create and suggestion credentials need separate explanations
findings.detail: GitHub project creation consumes a caller-bound selection code and rejects direct repository input. Blueprint suggestion still uses the retired ambient-token interface, which returns null in current DI, making its GitHub reads anonymous. Do not claim connected Repo App authority automatically flows into this suggestion service, and do not convert caller cancellation into a depicted normal fallback.

findings.subject: Skill disclosure is not unconditional lazy materialization
findings.detail: Materialization precedes pointer emission on a shared execution filesystem; pod-local or failed-write delivery inlines full instructions. Add the currently uncovered confirmed-team defaults preview/digest/apply behavior as prose.

findings.subject: Generation diagram omits public agent-definition copies
findings.detail: gen-docs computes five targets, including docs/public and deployed wwwroot copies. Preserve non-clobbering project materialization while adding these branches and correcting the three-output prose.

findings.subject: Testing coverage description is from an older auth and deployment model
findings.detail: The current repository contains executable OpenIddict consent/refresh tests, broker-only rejection tests, and real-process MCP/Assistant-token integration.
